image_pattern_summary: Verified good frisking booth images consistently show a black powder-coated MS frame structure with two rigid side panels (green ACP, grey ACP, or hardliner finish) and privacy curtains on a horizontal rod, photographed from a 3/4 angle on a white background or in a real deployment setting. Castor wheels at the base corners are visible in most images, confirming mobility. The full height of the booth (approximately 6–7 ft) is captured in a single frame, allowing buyers to assess the enclosure's privacy coverage.
